summary: A read-only Next.js demo app that consumes the Phoenix API and hosts bp-graph.js, a self-contained Canvas2D force-directed graph renderer styled after Obsidian's graph view for visualising document blast-radius in the Studio pane.

intentions.title: Visualise document connection graphs (blast-radius) inside the Studio
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js: BarkparkGraphRenderer, BFS depth layout, adjacency maps, node/edge ingest; integrated as a Phoenix LiveView hook (BarkparkGraph)

intentions.title: Obsidian-faithful minimalist aesthetic: restraint over spectacle
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js constants block: near-monochrome palette, flat BG, small flat dots (NODE_R_MIN/MAX 3.5–6px), thin faint threads, generous empty space; comments explicitly name Obsidian as the design thesis

intentions.title: Zero-dependency self-contained renderer (no npm, no CDN, no font fetch)
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js file header: 'ZERO npm, ZERO network-fetched libs, ZERO font fetch (Golden Rule)'; hand-rolled velocity-Verlet force sim, all colour math inlined

intentions.title: Smooth, polished interaction UX: eased zoom, hover cascade, idle breathing, pan inertia
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js: camTargetScale glide, BFS hop-cascade hover alpha, BREATH_FPS 12fps idle sway, pan inertia via lastMoves, easeOutBack entrance choreography

intentions.title: Full accessibility: keyboard navigation, a11y tree, live region, reduced-motion support
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js: canvas tabindex+role=application, parallel a11y role=tree DOM, aria-live polite liveRegion, reduceMQ prefers-reduced-motion branch (settleSync path), forced-colors detection

intentions.title: Stable view persistence across sessions and data updates
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js saveView/loadView via localStorage keyed by rootId+nodeSetHash; debounced save on wheel; diverged-camera guard (camFinite) to avoid persisting blown-up state

intentions.title: Unified document detail route with legacy redirect migration
intentions.evidence: next.config.ts: /posts/:slug and /papers/:slug 308-redirect to /d/[type]/[slug]; comment explains unified reader intent

intentions.title: Phantom node support: surface broken references without crashing the graph
intentions.evidence: bp-graph.js: phantom node detection, phantomByBrokenId map for O(1) edge resolution, phantom rendered as dim hollow dot at NODE_R_MIN
